subject: Taraxa — EU VAT status & PO billing entity alignment
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@taraxa.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ramesh Kumar <r.kumar@taraxa.co>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EU VAT registration and PO billing for Redwood

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the onboarding call earlier. A couple of follow-ups from our finance team as we start receiving POs from Redwood:

- We recently completed EU VAT registration under Maltese VAT ID MT12345678. Attached is the certificate and an excerpt of our GST filing in SG for your records.
- Do we need Redwood to issue POs to our Singapore entity or to our EU entity? Our legal prefers to invoice from Taraxa Ltd (Malta) when EU VAT is present, but we can also invoice from Taraxa Pte Ltd (SG) if you prefer reverse-charge treatment.
- What invoice fields does Redwood need to trigger reverse-charge (if applicable)? Do you require us to include your EU VAT number on our invoices, or will Redwood accept a net invoice with your EU entity VAT noted on the PO?

Attaching: Taraxa_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf, Taraxa_GST_Registration.pdf

Appreciate quick guidance — our quarter is closing and we'd like to align invoicing so POs and invoices match.

Best,
Sonia Patel
Head of Finance
Taraxa Technologies
attachments: Taraxa_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf (application/pdf), Taraxa_GST_Registration.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@taraxa.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EU VAT registration and PO billing for Redwood

Hi Sonia — thanks for the docs and the clear summary. Short answers and proposed path: 

- If Taraxa will be charging EU VAT (MT VAT shown) then we should route POs to our EU legal entity (Redwood EU Ltd). That ensures our AP team validates VAT lines and VAT reclaim workflows.
- If you prefer to invoice from Taraxa Pte Ltd (SG) and claim reverse-charge on our side, that is possible only if your invoice explicitly states your foreign (SG) entity and the invoice has no EU VAT line; Redwood will then apply reverse-charge accounting to the purchase. In that case we will need your EU VAT ID included on the invoice as well so our AP can validate registration.
- Required invoice fields for reverse-charge / EU VAT handling: vendor name, vendor legal entity, vendor VAT number, our EU entity name + VAT number on the PO, invoice currency, invoice line descriptions and the PO number. 

I've attached our procurement PO instructions that outline PO entity selection and required invoice fields for EU vendors. Can you confirm which legal entity Taraxa will invoice from going forward (Malta or SG)? Once you confirm we'll have Procurement issue POs to the matching vendor profile.

Next steps:
- Sonia: confirm billing entity (Taraxa Ltd / MT or Taraxa Pte Ltd / SG)
- Taraxa: include VAT number on invoices and mirror PO entity on invoice
- Procurement (cc'd): update vendor profile and push PO to the selected entity

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_procurement_po_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EU VAT registration and PO billing for Redwood

Priyom — quick internal note for AP/tax alignment: 

- If Taraxa invoices from Malta (MT VAT present) we should instruct AP to accept invoices gross (VAT line present) and treat as standard supplier invoices to Redwood EU Ltd. VAT reclaim will follow our claimant process.
- If Taraxa invoices from SG and we take reverse-charge, ensure the invoice explicitly states: "Reverse charge applies — Article X, VAT Directive (or local reference)" and includes Taraxa's EU VAT number for verification. AP must not net out VAT on the invoice — they should process net amount and post VAT on Redwood books via VAT reverse-charge entries.
- We should also check whether a fiscal representative is required for Taraxa in Malta; if so, request the fiscal rep name and registration docs.

I'll coordinate with Ben on system vendor profile mapping — Ben, please hold off migrating any open POs until Taraxa confirms the invoicing entity.

Thanks,
Karthik
Tax & Compliance (Advisory)
Redwood Inference

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@taraxa.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ramesh Kumar <r.kumar@taraxa.co>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EU VAT registration and PO billing for Redwood

Hi Priyom & team — thanks for the clarity. We will invoice from Taraxa Ltd (Malta) going forward for Redwood EU orders. Confirming details below: 

- VAT ID: MT12345678 (see attached certificate).
- We do not currently have a fiscal representative in Malta; Taraxa legal confirms local filing is direct.
- Preferred invoice currency: EUR. But we can provide SGD invoices on request.
- We will include: our legal entity name (Taraxa Ltd), VAT number, Redwood EU Ltd as billing reference and the PO number you provide.

A couple of asks: 
1) Can Redwood confirm the exact EU billing entity name and VAT number you want on the PO so it matches our invoices?
2) Will Redwood accept an invoice with a separate VAT line (standard VAT) or does Redwood prefer reverse-charge entries? You flagged both options previously — since Taraxa is charging VAT in Malta we expect Redwood to take the gross invoice path (Redwood EU Ltd) unless you direct otherwise.

Attaching Taraxa_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf again for AP.

Best,
Sonia
attachments: Taraxa_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.patel@taraxa.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EU VAT registration and PO billing for Redwood

Thanks Sonia — that works. Finalized approach and action list below so AP and Taraxa are aligned: 

Final decision:
- Redwood will accept invoices from Taraxa Ltd (Malta) with VAT charged on the invoice. Procurement will issue POs to Redwood EU Ltd. AP will process the invoice gross and reclaim VAT where applicable.

Invoice/PO fields we need (exact text to appear on both documents):
- Vendor legal name: Taraxa Ltd
- Vendor VAT number: MT12345678
- Bill-to: Redwood EU Ltd, VAT NL98765432 (example EU VAT for Redwood EU) <- Procurement will insert the exact VAT at PO creation; please mirror that exactly on invoices.
- PO number: mandatory
- Invoice currency: EUR (preferred)
- Line item descriptions and tax amount per line

Action items: 
- Taraxa: send signed copy of tax registration (received) and confirm bank details to appear on invoice.
- Procurement (Laura): create vendor profile for Taraxa Ltd (Malta) in Coupa (or our vendor system) and set default billing entity to Redwood EU Ltd. 
- AP (Ben): configure VAT reclaim workflow for Malta VAT on this vendor; flag invoices for manual review first month to confirm VAT amounts.
- Karthik: please advise if we need to log any additional tax documentation against the vendor profile — if not, we can proceed.

Sonia — can you please share your preferred remittance bank details and a sample invoice (PDF) after you have a PO? I'll have Laura create the vendor profile as soon as we have bank details.

Linking our procurement guide and the PO entity mapping doc here: https://docs.redwood.internal/procurement/po-entity-mapping (internal)
DocuSign for MSA addendum (if Taraxa wants a tax addendum): https://docusign.example.com/embedded/signon?token=XYZ-1234

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Sonia
